## Brief

*You will choose an application domain that your group will work with during Sprint Assessment 0-1.
*Your challenge is to perform a literature review of the resources for helping you do data science in your chosen application domain.

## Application domain

We decided to focus our project on football matches predictions and are focusing on the following question:
Q: Can we predict the Premier League 2026/2027 match results?

*What are the broad types of data?
Each of us found different types of data containing information about football matches and players. We chose two datasets: one containing match events and the other containing player statistics. We chose these because we believe that, to build a classification model that predicts match outcomes, we need both data from previous matches and player statistics, such as performance and skills.
*What are the main types of resource? 
We found public datasets on websites such as Kaggle and other sites that share match statistics. We also researched articles related to our classification model. These can be found in each team member’s folder. In our individual reflections, we explain how we connected the articles to our project.
*What type of problems can the resources solve?
The datasets helped us understand if match events and player statistics are useful for predicting football match outcomes. The articles provide examples of how statistical methods can be used to make these predictions. These resources could help us build a model to predict match results and understand which features might affect a team’s performance.
*Are there any generic data science resources that might be applicable? In what sense are they applicable? 
*How might the approach be compared to other approaches, and/or applied across different datasets? 
*How is the experience of sharing code via GitHub limiting, and/or enabling?



## Extra Notes
The data we were looking for:
Match Results in a specific tournament
Odds of the match
Time of day
Day of the week 
Whether the games were played home or away
Teams playing in that tournament
Players in the teams
Data on the players

Possible additions: 
Weather data

We decided to look at data on Priemier League since every team has equal amount of games played, compared to the World Cup where there is a hierarchy system. This gives us more data to train a model, and to test. 

Q: Can we predict the Premier League 2026/2027 season champion?
